title: Broadway take notes 📝👀 #WestEnd #Broadway #LondonTheatre #WestEndThea...
transcript: Here are three things I think the West End does better than Broadway. The first is arguably my favourite, and that is intermission ice cream. Every single show on the West End serves ice cream during its intermission, and it is, in my opinion, the best intermission snack. Is it overpriced? Yes, but did I buy it every time? Also yes. Second is superior start times. Their matinees tend to start at 2:30 and their evening shows tend to start at 7:30. And 7:30 especially is just the perfect start time. I feel like eight PM always feels too late, and seven PM feels too early and cuts into dinner a little bit. I really don't know why Broadway insists that shows have to start on the hour. 7:30 is where it's at. And finally, the last thing is staggered matinees. On Broadway and the West End shows tend to do two two show days, but on Broadway it's almost always Wednesday and Saturday. But on the West End, while all shows do Saturday matinees, their second matinee date varies across the shows, meaning some will do Monday, some will do Tuesday, some will do Wednesday, some will do Thursday, even a few Fridays. So while I was only in London for eight days, I was able to squeeze in 15 shows because of the varied schedules, whereas with that same amount of time on Broadway, you can really only squeeze in eight shows. So really ideal for crazy people like me who like To cram in as much theater as possible to one trip.
